hero_one.title: Rodrigo Carvalho
hero_one.description: I’m a 21-year-old software developer specialised in backend development. I began my programming journey 7 years ago, and over the past few years, I’ve been consolidating my skills through the Technical Specialist in Information Systems Technologies and Programming course at the Instituto do Emprego e Formação Profissional in Évora, Portugal.

hero_two.title: About Me
hero_two.subtitle: Software Developer
hero_two.description: Hi, my name is Rodrigo Carvalho. I’m a 21-year-old software developer focused on building business applications. With 7 years of hands-on programming experience, I’ve specialised in backend development, creating efficient, secure, and scalable solutions. I’m currently attending the Technical Specialist in Information Systems Technologies and Programming course at the Instituto do Emprego e Formação Profissional in Évora, Portugal, where I continue to deepen my skills in areas such as databases, APIs, system integration, and security. I’m driven by a passion for continuous learning and innovation, always exploring new ways to apply technology to real-world challenges. If you're looking for someone dedicated, analytical, and ready to tackle tech challenges, I’m here to help.

hero_four.Title: Experience
hero_four.parsisplan: I interned at Parsisplan for over 1 year through the IEFP in Évora. I had an amazing experience at the company; I was warmly welcomed and always received all the necessary support. Today, much of what I know is thanks to the people at the company. I worked on some projects that I can't discuss due to company confidentiality, but it was an incredible experience and I am grateful for the opportunity.
hero_four.novabit: This company is focused on hardware and network systems. I interned there for about 2 months and learned some things, such as NAS systems and RAID configurations. Although it was not one of my best experiences due to some internal issues, I was able to gain some knowledge.
